rationale: Checks documentation claims and missing setup coverage against code and configuration.
Legal approval and enforceability judgments fall outside the supplied skill descriptions.
Assesses another agent’s critique against the request and repository and asks for a verdict and required corrections.
Investigates a repeatedly unresolved bug through reproduction and comparison with the last working release before edits.
Audits help, privacy, and architecture descriptions against the actual pipeline and retention configuration.
Requests a read-only patch acceptance review against specified behavior with cited deviations.
Requests implementation of an agreed fix and running existing relevant tests; no supplied skill covers that implementation directly.
Requests a wording-only edit of supplied prose while preserving its voice.
Closes the current session with Git status and durable notes for resuming remaining work.
Requests a self-contained assignment for another coding assistant with boundaries, deliverables, and completion checks.
Requests a read-only review of a diff against a specification with ranked, located mismatches.
Requests cause investigation of an environment-specific failure using the previous working revision and configuration before changes.
